title: status bar at the bottom of the Tracks editor: editable cursor position + time formats + relocated minimap

decisions.text: Layout restructure (owner req. 1). The TracksPanel root becomes a 3-zone flex column: (1) toolbar (flex:0 0 auto), (2) a scrollable tracks region (flex:1 1 auto; overflow:auto) that now owns everything currently scrolling (the sticky header stays sticky INSIDE it, gtrack stack, overall wave/spectrum), and (3) a fixed status bar (flex:0 0 auto) OUTSIDE the scroll, always visible. Moving overflow:auto off the root must not break the sticky header (top:-16px compensates the root's 16px padding), the --tp-* overlay-frame pinning (GT10.27 measureOverlayFrame), or scrollIntoView (GT10.28).

Minimap relocates into the status bar top row (owner req. 3). .audio-page__minimap-wrap (SpectrogramMinimap + SF26 mode gear) is lifted out of the bottom of the scroll flow and becomes the status bar's top row. Alignment: the minimap wrapper gets padding-left:46px; padding-right:8px (= GTrackView AXIS_MARGIN {left:46,right:8}) so the minimap's t=0 lines up with the graphs' plot-area left edge and free space remains on the right. Minimap view/zoom/pan behaviour unchanged; the mode gear sits in the free right margin.

Status bar = new TrackStatusBar.vue component (GnauralCore/ui/components). Props: positionSec, durationSec, sampleRate, format; a top slot/region for the minimap; emits update:positionSec (seek) and update:format. Host TracksPanel passes gtrackPlayheadSec/spectrogramDuration and maps update:positionSec -> handleSeek. Keeps layout in one testable place.

Pure time-format module time-format.ts + tests. The 7 owner formats (req 2b) as a const/enum; formatTime(sec, fmt, sampleRate), parseTime(str, fmt, sampleRate) (reverse parse for editing, req 2a), autoPickFormat(durationSec). Parse tolerant to partial input within a format; result clamped to [0, durationSec]. Bun round-trip tests format->parse per format.

Auto-pick + per-file persistence (req 2b; LOCKED owner 2026-07-14). Set is 6 formats -- owner dropped 'hh:mm:ss + samples'. autoPickFormat by duration (thresholds CONFIRMED by owner): <60s -> sec+millis; <1h -> hh:mm:ss+hundredths; <24h -> hh:mm:ss; >=24h -> dd:hh:mm:ss. An explicit user pick overrides auto-pick and persists per file (localStorage mindwave-tracks-timeformat = {[filePath]: formatId}, the use-gtrack-lanes pattern); no saved pick -> auto. sampleRate no longer needed (samples format removed); R2 closed.

Position editable, duration read-only, both in the current format (req 2a/2c). Position field commits on Enter/blur -> parseTime -> clamp -> handleSeek; while playing it shows the live position ONLY when not being edited (R4). Duration uses the same format, read-only.

Horizontal gap 2px (req 4; LOCKED owner 2026-07-14). The root .audio-page__output-section left/right padding drops from 16px to 2px (padding:16px 2px); top/bottom stay 16px so the sticky header's top:-16px compensation is unchanged. Does not affect minimap alignment (that relies on AXIS_MARGIN inside the canvas, not the section padding).

steps.title: Модуль time-format.ts: 6 форматов + formatTime/parseTime/autoPickFormat + bun-тесты
steps.verify: bun test ui (round-trip format->parse per format; autoPick thresholds; clamp)
evidence: time-format.ts: TimeFormat (6, samples dropped) + formatTime/parseTime/clampSec/autoPickFormat. Formatting decomposes an integer count of the format's smallest unit (1s/1/100s/1/1000s) so second/minute fields never roll over from FP; parseTime is lenient (decimal comma, fewer colon-groups read right-to-left); autoPick thresholds locked per owner 2026-07-14.

time-format.test.ts: 21 tests / 85 expect() pass (bun test) — per-format formatting incl. no-rollover at 59.999s, right-to-left lenient parse, round-trip format->parse within each format's resolution, clamp, autoPick thresholds + degenerate durations.
MindWaveCore/ui vue-tsc --noEmit: 0 errors.

steps.title: Реструктуризация раскладки TracksPanel + переезд минимапа в низ, выравнивание по оси (req 1, 3)
steps.verify: vue-tsc + quasar build; manual: minimap не уезжает при скролле, t=0 совпадает с осью, sticky header + --tp-* панели работают
evidence: TracksPanel root .audio-page__output-section--spectrogram: overflow auto -> hidden + flex:1/min-height:0; the tracks stack now scrolls inside a new .tracks-panel__scroll (flex:1; overflow:auto; position:relative so lane absolute descendants still anchor/scroll as before). Toolbar/banners stay above it.

Minimap (.audio-page__minimap-wrap + SF26 mode gear) moved OUT of the scrolling .col into a new .tracks-panel__statusbar (flex:0 0 auto) pinned below the scroll region -> always visible (req 1). Wrapped in .tracks-panel__statusbar-minimap with padding-left:46/right:8 (= GTrackView AXIS_MARGIN) so the minimap t=0 aligns with the graph plot-area left edge and free space remains on the right where the gear sits (req 3).

Sticky header top -16px -> 0 (its sticky ancestor is now .tracks-panel__scroll, no padding of its own). Flyouts unaffected: measureOverlayFrame still measures rootEl's rect and the capture scroll listener still catches the inner scroll.
Verify: MindWaveCore/ui vue-tsc 0 errors; quasar build OK; GnauralCore bun test ui 180 pass. Runtime layout confirmed by owner at SB2.5 (after SB2.2).

steps.title: TrackStatusBar.vue: редактируемая позиция + шестерёнка форматов (per file, авто-подбор) + read-only длительность (req 2)
steps.verify: vue-tsc + quasar build; manual: правка позиции во всех 6 форматах -> seek; авто-подбор + персист per file; i18n названий форматов
evidence: TrackStatusBar.vue: presentational component with props positionSec/durationSec/format and emits update:positionSec/update:format. Row = editable position q-input + format gear (q-menu over TIME_FORMATS, current checked) + read-only duration. Position field mirrors the live playhead while not focused (follows playback, R4); on Enter/blur -> parseTime -> clampSec(_, duration) -> emit; Esc reverts. Minimap rendered by the host into the #minimap slot on top. Root .track-status-bar is flex:0 0 auto (pinned strip).

TracksPanel: timeFormat computed = per-file saved pick (localStorage mindwave-tracks-timeformat = {[filePath]: format}) else autoPickFormat(duration); setTimeFormat persists per file (SB-D5). Wired <track-status-bar :position-sec=gtrackPlayheadSec??0 :duration-sec=spectrogramDuration :format=timeFormat @update:position-sec=handleSeek @update:format=setTimeFormat> with the minimap in the slot.
i18n: audio.statusPosition/statusDuration/statusTimeFormat + timeFormat_{sec,sec_ms,hms,dhms,hms_cs,hms_ms} in en.json + ru.json (owner's verbatim Russian format names).
Verify: MindWaveCore/ui vue-tsc 0 errors; quasar build OK; GnauralCore bun test ui 180 pass. Runtime UX confirmed by owner at SB2.5.

steps.title: Горизонтальный зазор 2px: .audio-page__output-section padding 16px 2px (req 4, SB-D7)
steps.verify: vue-tsc + quasar build; manual: треки прижаты к границе на 2px; sticky header + выравнивание минимапа не поехали
evidence: .audio-page__output-section--spectrogram gets padding-left/right:2px (top/bottom stay 16px, folded into the SB2.1 rule) — Tracks tab only. Sticky-header top:0 and minimap AXIS_MARGIN alignment are unaffected (they don't depend on the horizontal padding).
Verify: MindWaveCore/ui quasar build OK (vue-tsc already clean from SB2.2). Visual confirmation by owner at SB2.5.

steps.title: Доработки по проверке SB2.5 (feedback #1-3): шапка над скролбаром; шестерёнка+стрелочки в рамке позиции; сегментный шаг
steps.verify: vue-tsc + quasar build; manual: скролбар не касается шапки; стрелочки меняют сегмент под курсором во всех форматах
evidence: #1: the header .audio-page__spectrogram-header moved OUT of .tracks-panel__scroll to a flex:0 0 auto row ABOVE it (no longer position:sticky/z-40) — the tracks scrollbar now spans only the lane region and never runs past the header.
#2: the format gear moved into the position field via q-input #append (inside the outlined frame), replacing the standalone button.

#3: segment step arrows added left of the gear (inside the frame) + ArrowUp/Down keys. The caret's group = separators (':'/'.') before it; per-format unit map (sec/sec_ms/hms/dhms/hms_cs/hms_ms -> days/hours/min/sec/hundredths/millis). step() parses buf, +/- the segment unit, clamps to duration, emits seek, reformats, and re-selects the same group so repeated steps stay on that field. i18n statusStepUp/Down (en+ru).
Verify: MindWaveCore/ui vue-tsc 0 errors; quasar build OK; GnauralCore bun test ui 180 pass. Runtime confirmed by owner at SB2.5.

steps.title: Доработки 2-й итерации: авто-ширина поля позиции; тогл показать/скрыть минимап; подпись формата под значением
steps.verify: vue-tsc + quasar build; manual: поле сужается/расширяется под формат; тогл скрывает минимап и уменьшает высоту; формат виден под значением
evidence: #1 auto-width: the position field is wrapped in a column whose width = fieldWidth computed = calc(max(len,4)ch + 78px); the input fills it and uses tabular-nums so each digit is one ch -> the frame tracks the formatted value per format. Fixed 210px removed.

#2 minimap toggle: TrackStatusBar gets minimapVisible prop + update:minimapVisible emit; a 'map' q-btn on the right (q-space before it) toggles it. The #minimap slot is v-if=minimapVisible (not v-show) so hiding drops the row and the status bar shrinks by the minimap height. Host persists globally (localStorage mindwave-tracks-minimap-hidden). i18n statusToggleMinimap.
#3 format caption: t(audio.timeFormat_<format>) shown under the value in a 10px muted caption (.track-status-bar__format).
Verify: MindWaveCore/ui vue-tsc 0 errors; quasar build OK; GnauralCore bun test ui 180 pass. Runtime confirmed by owner at SB2.5.

steps.title: Убрать Позицию/Длительность из верхней meta-полосы редактора (дубль статус-бара)
steps.verify: vue-tsc + quasar build; manual: в верхней meta-полосе больше нет Позиция/Длительность; статус-бар их показывает
evidence: AudioPage top meta strip: the two metric cells (audio.position/positionLabel, audio.duration/durationLabel) removed — they duplicated the new Tracks status bar. positionLabel/durationLabel dropped from the useAudioTransport destructuring (still exported by the composable, unused now). Only the file dropdown remains in the strip.
Verify: MindWaveCore/ui vue-tsc 0 errors; quasar build OK; GnauralCore bun test ui 180 pass.

steps.title: Статус-бар рендерится безусловно (owner req.): виден сразу при открытии вкладки, без ожидания рендера файла; минимап внутри — по наличию данных
steps.verify: vue-tsc + quasar build; manual: открыть большой файл — статус-бар (поля позиции/длительности) виден мгновенно, минимап появляется, когда готовы данные; без открытого файла статус-бар тоже присутствует
evidence: Owner req.: on opening a large, slow-to-render file the status bar appeared with a big delay because <track-status-bar> was gated on 'showSpectrogram && hasSpectrogramData'. Removed that v-if — the bar is now rendered unconditionally so it is present the moment the Tracks tab is shown, independent of whether a file is open or still rendering. positionSec/durationSec degrade to 0 (formatTime(0) is valid) and timeFormat falls back to autoPickFormat(0)=sec_ms.

The minimap needs real data to draw, so the #minimap slot content (.tracks-panel__statusbar-minimap) got its own v-if='hasSpectrogramData': while nothing is open (or a big file is still rendering) the bar shows just the fields row and the minimap appears once analysis/duration are ready.
Verify: MindWaveCore/ui vue-tsc 0 errors; quasar build OK.

steps.title: PAUSE: owner-проверка статус-бара (всегда виден; позиция во всех форматах; авто-подбор+персист; минимап по оси; зазор 2px; шапка над скролбаром; шестерёнка+стрелочки в рамке; авто-ширина; тогл минимапа; подпись формата; верхние Позиция/Длительность убраны)

log.text: Plan + ledger created for the Tracks-editor bottom status bar (owner req. 2026-07-14): always-visible bottom status bar with editable cursor position, selectable time formats (auto-picked by duration, persisted per file), read-only duration, and the minimap relocated to the status bar top aligned to the graphs' vertical axis (AXIS_MARGIN left:46/right:8). Decisions SB-D1..D6 proposed; owner review at the PAUSE step.

Owner follow-up (2026-07-14): (1) auto-pick thresholds confirmed; (2) 'hh:mm:ss + samples' format dropped -> 6 formats, sampleRate no longer needed (R2 closed); (3) new req 4 -> reduce the tracks' left/right gap to the editor border to 2px. Added SB-D7 + step SB2.3 (padding), SB-D5 locked, PAUSE renumbered SB2.3 -> SB2.5.

SB1.1..SB2.3 implemented + committed. Owner SB2.5 review feedback (#1-3) -> SB2.6: header moved above the scroll region (scrollbar no longer runs past it); format gear moved inside the position field frame; segment step arrows (+ Up/Down keys) that change the field the caret sits in. Also fixed the ledger: SB2.1/2.2/2.3 statuses were left 'todo' by narrow evidence edits though committed -> set to 'done'.

Owner req.: opening a large, slow-rendering file made the status bar appear with a big delay -> SB2.9: render <track-status-bar> unconditionally (dropped the 'showSpectrogram && hasSpectrogramData' gate) so it shows the instant the Tracks tab is up, regardless of file/render state; the data-dependent minimap inside is gated on hasSpectrogramData instead.
